environment.description: EC2 c5.large running Amazon Linux 2, legacy monolith compiled with gcc 7.3 without ASAN. Process runs as root with full filesystem access. glibc 2.26 tcache enabled (exploitable double-free via tcache poisoning). No ASLR (kernel.randomize_va_space=0 set for legacy compatibility). Service exposed on port 8080 via public ENI with no NLB or filtering.
